title: Google Calendar
banner: See your meetings beside your time, and add them in a click.
intro: Connect your Google Calendar and your week shows your meetings beside your time, to add as time or start the clock on.
what: Timeclock only reads when your events are and what they’re called, to show them on your week. It never changes your calendar, and keeps none of it.
managed: Your organization connects your Google Calendar for you, so your week already shows your meetings.
unavailable: Your server administrator hasn’t set up connecting Google Calendars.
denied: Your calendar wasn’t connected: Google wasn’t given access.
failed: Your calendar couldn’t be connected. Try again.

feed.title: Subscribe to holidays and time off
feed.intro: Add a calendar of the company’s holidays and who’s out to Google Calendar, or any calendar app that subscribes by link. It keeps itself up to date.
feed.private: Anyone with the link can see the calendar, so keep it to yourself. It shows that someone is out, never why; your own days say vacation or sick.
feed.once: This link is shown only now. Copy it, or add it to Google Calendar, before you leave this page.
feed.googleDelay: Google Calendar can take several hours to show a change.
feed.on: Your calendar link is on, made {date}.
feed.lost: Lost the link, or shared it by mistake? Make a new one: the old one stops working.
feed.offFailed: Couldn’t turn your calendar link off.
